financial_summary: Vox Royalty Corp. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $342M market cap on $12M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +12% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 80% confirm genuine pricing power.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 9.4×.

Shareholder yield is only 0.8%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 11% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 5.0× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
